summary: Indian stocks reopen after a holiday with mixed overnight cues: hotter US inflation knocked Wall Street lower and lifted rate-hike bets, while cheaper oil offers a cushion.

detail.leaders: Oil-sensitive names such as paints, airlines and OMCs could find support as crude eases
detail.laggards: IT and other rate-sensitive, US-linked names face pressure from higher US yields
detail.tone: A forward-looking read for the first session after Tuesday's holiday. The cues are less supportive than on Monday night, when a strong US rally pointed to a firm start; the inflation surprise has since tempered that.

top.title: US inflation runs hotter than expected
top.line: October CPI rose 0.4% vs 0.3% forecast; core rose 0.3% vs 0.2%

No year-on-year figure: last year's shutdown halted October 2025 data
Markets raised bets on a December Fed rate hike
One report put the US 10-year yield near 5.00% after the data
